enriched_activities.desc: Lies down in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Remains asleep. Stirs. Turns to back. Continues sleeping. Wakes briefly. Turns over. Goes back to sleep. Finally opens eyes at 06:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Grabs towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around body. Walks to sink. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast (toast and tea)
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Takes out bread, butter, and milk from refrigerator. Takes out toaster. Places bread in toaster. Takes out plate, knife, and mug. Toaster pops. Places toast on plate. Spreads butter. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Pours water into mug. Adds tea bag. Removes tea bag. Adds milk. Stir. Carries plate and mug to table. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Carries plate and mug to sink. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps Myki card. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to train station. Waits for train. Train arrives. Boards train. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Train arrives at Clayton. Gets off train. Walks to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending business lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Enters lecture hall. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out laptop. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Takes out notebook. Takes out pen. Listens to lecture. Types notes on laptop. Writes notes in notebook. Raises hand to ask question. Answers question. Participates in group discussion. Stands up. Walks to next class. Enters tutorial room. Sits down. Opens laptop. Continues taking notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at the campus food court
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to food court. Joins queue. Orders food. Pays. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Talks with friends. Clears table. Throws away trash. Walks to library.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying and working on assignments in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Enters library. Finds study spot. Sits down. Opens laptop. Connects to Wi-Fi. Opens assignment file. Reads instructions. Types. Takes notes. Highlights text. Searches online. Reads article. Writes summary. Stands up. Walks to bookshelf. Finds book. Returns to seat. Continues working. Prints document. Collects printout.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits. Boards bus. Taps card. Sits. Checks phone. Gets off. Walks to train station. Waits. Boards train. Sits. Gets off at Chadstone. Walks to shopping center.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time retail shift at Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Enters store. Greets manager. Clocks in. Puts on uniform. Walks to shop floor. Folds clothes. Organizes racks. Assists customer. Answers questions. Uses register. Processes payment. Bags items. Restocks shelves. Checks inventory. Takes break. Continues working. Helps another customer. Cleans counter. Clocks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Dinner break at the Chadstone food court
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to food court. Orders food. Pays. Receives food. Finds table. Sits. Unwraps food. Uses fork. Eats. Drinks. Checks phone. Throws trash. Walks back to store.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing part-time retail shift at Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Returns to shop floor. Assists customer. Folds clothes. Rearranges display. Uses register. Processes payment. Bags items. Answers phone. Restocks. Checks fitting rooms. Cleans. Helps another customer. Clocks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by public transport from Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits. Boards bus. Taps card. Sits. Checks phone. Gets off. Walks to train station. Waits. Boards train. Sits. Gets off at home station. Walks home.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light snack and warm drink, tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread and butter. Closes refrigerator. Takes out toaster. Places bread in toaster. Takes out plate and knife. Toaster pops. Places toast on plate. Spreads butter. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Pours water into mug. Adds tea bag. Removes tea bag. Eats snack. Drinks tea. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps in. Washes body. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Grabs towel. Dries body. Wraps towel. Walks to sink. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Dries face. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone, reviewing notes for tomorrow, then going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on light. Sits on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Checks messages. Scrolls social media. Opens notes app. Reviews notes. Picks up notebook. Reads notes. Closes notebook. Turns off light. Lies down. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Falls asleep.
